phases.title: Activation & Technique
phases.goal: Establish mind-muscle connection, learn movement patterns, build foundational glute activation.

phases.title: Load & Volume Build
phases.goal: Increase training weight and add a fourth set to primary exercises.

phases.title: Intensification
phases.goal: Peak phase. Heavier loads, drop sets on hip thrusts, superset pairings.

sessions.title: Glute Foundation — Day A: Drive
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll hamstrings and TFL 60s each. Banded lateral walk 2x15. Cat-cow 10 reps.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Supine spinal twist 60s each side. Diaphragmatic breathing 10 breaths.
sessions.sessionNotes: Hip thrust is the priority movement. Take time to set up correctly. Use lighter load if form breaks.

exercises.loadGuidance: Moderate — you should complete all reps with 2 reps left in the tank
exercises.progressionNotes: Add 5kg when all 3 sets are achieved with RPE below 7

exercises.loadGuidance: Moderate — feet high and wide on plate
exercises.progressionNotes: Add 5-10kg each session if form is solid

exercises.loadGuidance: Light to moderate — focus on feeling hamstrings load
exercises.progressionNotes: Increase 2.5kg per dumbbell when all reps achieved

exercises.loadGuidance: Bodyweight or light load — this is a glute exercise, not back
exercises.progressionNotes: Add load once glute contraction is felt clearly
Increase weight by one plate once all sets hit
Progress to 45 seconds

sessions.title: Glute Foundation — Day B: Hinge
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll hamstrings and TFL 60s each. Banded clamshell 2x12. Hip circle 10 each direction.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Child pose 60s. Supine spinal twist 60s each side.
sessions.sessionNotes: Focus on feeling the hamstrings load on RDL descent. Do not rush. Hip hinge pattern is the foundation of all posterior chain work.

exercises.progressionNotes: Increase 5kg when all sets complete and form perfect

exercises.loadGuidance: Moderate — conventional stance, focus on hip drive at top
exercises.progressionNotes: Deadlift added in week 3. Start very light.
Step height to hip height is glute-dominant
Add ankle weight once 15 reps feels easy
Progress to medium band
3-second hold per rep

sessions.title: Glute Foundation — Day C: Shape
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll quads 60s each. Banded lateral walk 2x15. Bird dog 2x8 each side.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Hip flexor somatic release 90s each side. Deep breathing 10 rounds.
sessions.sessionNotes: Unilateral day. Expect left-right differences — this is normal. Move at a pace where you can feel the target muscles.

exercises.progressionNotes: Aim for left-right parity before increasing load
Balance is the challenge — use wall for support if needed
Lateral lunge variation — targets glute med
Add medium band once form is solid
Second abduction exercise in this session
Core work — slow and controlled

sessions.title: Glute Build — Day A: Drive+
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll hamstrings 60s. Banded lateral walk 2x15. Cat-cow 10 reps.
sessions.sessionNotes: Now 4 sets on hip thrust. Increase weight if you hit all reps with good form last week.

exercises.progressionNotes: Progressive overload from Foundation. Add 2.5–5kg from last phase.
Full depth goblet squat. Pause at bottom 1 second.
Long stride, upright torso. Drive through front heel.
Squeeze glutes hard at top. 2 second hold.
Step up, drive knee high. Control the descent.
Full hip extension. Squeeze at top.

sessions.title: Glute Build — Day B: Hinge+
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll hamstrings and TFL. Clamshell 2x15. Hip circle 10 each direction.
sessions.sessionNotes: Add load to RDL. Begin introducing pause at bottom of RDL for 1 second to increase time under tension.

exercises.progressionNotes: Barbell or dumbbell. Push hips back, soft knees.
Hip hinge on one leg. Keep hips square.
Slow eccentric 3 seconds. Feel hamstring stretch.
Use eccentric lowering if full reps too hard.
Curl heels to glutes. Hips stay high.
Hinge pattern. Squeeze glutes to stand.

sessions.title: Glute Build — Day C: Shape+
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll quads. Banded lateral walk 2x20. Bird dog 2x10.
sessions.sessionNotes: Bulgarian split squat is introduced here. Start with bodyweight for first session before adding dumbbells.

exercises.progressionNotes: Constant tension. Stay low in mini squat.
Drive through heel. Full hip extension.
Controlled extension. Hold top 1 second.
Glute squeeze at top. Slow descent.
Full hip extension. No lower back arch.
Band above knees. Push knees out at top.

sessions.title: Glute Peak — Day A: Power Drive
sessions.warmupNotes: Full lower body warm-up protocol: foam roll, lateral walk, clamshell, cat-cow.
sessions.sessionNotes: Peak phase. Hip thrust load should now be challenging. Consider adding pause reps or 1.5 rep technique.

exercises.progressionNotes: Peak phase — heaviest hip thrust of program. 2 second squeeze at top.
Explosive power. Full hip extension on landing.
Rear foot elevated. Deep range. Control eccentric.
Heavy barbell. Full hip extension.
Explosive. Land soft with knees tracking toes.
Weighted. Drive knee high at top.

sessions.title: Glute Peak — Day B: Deep Hinge
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll full lower body. Dynamic warm-up.
sessions.sessionNotes: Introduce sumo or single-leg RDL variation for variety and stimulus.

exercises.progressionNotes: Sumo or conventional. Peak strength phase.
Slow eccentric 4 seconds. Maximum stretch.
If no GHR machine, use Nordic curl regression.
Moderate load. Deep hinge pattern.
Eccentric focus. Slow lowering.
Light load burnout. Full squeeze each rep.

sessions.title: Glute Peak — Day C: Finisher
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll. Activation drills.
sessions.sessionNotes: Add a glute pump finisher: 3 rounds of banded clamshell + donkey kickback + glute bridge, no rest between exercises.

exercises.progressionNotes: Heavy band. Constant tension. Stay low.
Weighted. Full hip extension each rep.
Explosive from kneeling to standing.
Controlled. 1 second pause at extension.
Stability challenge. Slow and controlled.
Final burnout. High reps, feel the squeeze.

phases.title: Foundation (3x10-12)
phases.goal: Establish compound movement technique. 3 sets of 10-12 with moderate load.

phases.title: Hypertrophy (4x8-10)
phases.goal: Increase to 4 sets. Reduce reps. Add load. Introduce superset pairings.

phases.title: Strength-Hypertrophy (4x6-8)
phases.goal: Reverse pyramid loading. Heavy primary sets, back-off volume sets.

sessions.title: Strength — Day 1: Push (Chest, Shoulders, Triceps)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min incline walk or bike. Arm circles, band pull-aparts 2x15, push-up warm-up 2x10.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Chest stretch doorway 60s. Tricep cross-body stretch 30s each.
sessions.sessionNotes: Push day. Incline press is the primary movement. Take all warm-up sets seriously. Log every weight.

exercises.loadGuidance: Load where last 2 reps are challenging but form is perfect
exercises.progressionNotes: Add 2.5kg per side when all 3 sets achieved at RPE 6.5

exercises.loadGuidance: Moderate — seated version recommended for beginners
exercises.progressionNotes: Add 2kg per DB when all reps achieved

exercises.loadGuidance: Light — control matters more than weight here
exercises.progressionNotes: Increase 1kg only
Increase 1kg per side
Progress to 45s

sessions.title: Strength — Day 2: Pull (Back, Biceps)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min row or bike. Band pull-aparts 2x15. Dead hangs 2x20s.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Lat stretch 60s each side. Bicep doorway stretch 30s.
sessions.sessionNotes: Pull day. Barbell or dumbbell row is the anchor. Lat pulldown is the assistance.

exercises.progressionNotes: Add 2kg per DB when all sets complete
Add weight when last set hits 12 with 2 reps in reserve
Add 1kg per DB
This exercise stays light. Focus on quality.
Progress to 45s

sessions.title: Strength — Day 3: Lower (Legs, Glutes)
sessions.warmupNotes: Foam roll quads and hamstrings. Banded lateral walk 2x15. Goblet squat warm-up 2x10.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Hip flexor release 90s each. Supine spinal twist.
sessions.sessionNotes: Lower day. Squat and deadlift are primary movements. Glute accessory work included.

exercises.loadGuidance: Moderate-heavy — this is the primary strength movement
exercises.progressionNotes: Add 5kg total when all sets complete at RPE 7

exercises.loadGuidance: Heavy — this is a primary movement. Safety matters.
exercises.progressionNotes: Add 5kg when form is perfect and RPE is under 7.5
Add 5kg to bar when all reps achieved
Increase 2kg per DB
Increase one plate
Progress to 45s

sessions.title: Strength — Day 4: Upper (Full Upper Body)
sessions.warmupNotes: Band pull-aparts 2x15. Face pull 2x15. Shoulder circles.
sessions.sessionNotes: Upper day. Balanced push-pull. Shoulder health work (face pull) is non-negotiable every session.

exercises.progressionNotes: Add 2kg per DB when all sets achieved
Add 2.5kg when complete
Add 1kg per DB
Add 1kg per DB
Always included. Always light.
Core anti-rotation work

sessions.title: Hypertrophy — Day 1: Push (Chest, Shoulders, Triceps)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min incline walk. Band pull-aparts 2x15. Light DB press warm-up 2x10.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Chest stretch doorway 60s. Tricep stretch 30s each.
sessions.sessionNotes: Increase to 4 sets. Reduce reps. Add load. Introduce superset pairings.

exercises.loadGuidance: Increase weight from Phase 1. Control the eccentric.
Bodyweight. Add weight plate on back if easy.

sessions.title: Hypertrophy — Day 2: Pull (Back, Biceps)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min row or bike. Band pull-aparts 2x15. Dead hangs 2x20s.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Lat stretch 60s each side. Bicep doorway stretch 30s.
sessions.sessionNotes: Heavier rows. Pull volume increases. Superset curls with face pulls.

exercises.loadGuidance: Heavier than Phase 1. Drive elbow to hip.
Full stretch at top. Squeeze at bottom.
Superset with face pulls. Full ROM.
Superset with curls. Light band or cable.

sessions.title: Hypertrophy — Day 3: Lower (Legs, Glutes)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min bike. Bodyweight squats 2x10. Banded lateral walks 2x12.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Quad stretch 60s each. Pigeon stretch 60s each.
sessions.sessionNotes: Squat and RDL volume increases. Add leg press or lunges as accessory.

exercises.loadGuidance: Add load from Phase 1. Full depth.
Barbell or heavy DB. Drive through heels.
Bodyweight or light DB. Balance focus.

sessions.title: Hypertrophy — Day 4: Upper (Full Upper Body)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min bike. Arm circles, band pull-aparts 2x15.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Full upper body stretch sequence 5 min.
sessions.sessionNotes: Balanced push-pull. Higher volume. Shoulder health work every session.

exercises.loadGuidance: Light. Shoulder health essential every session.

sessions.title: Strength — Day 1: Push (Chest, Shoulders, Triceps)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min incline walk. Band pull-aparts 2x15. Ramp-up sets to working weight.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Chest stretch doorway 60s. Tricep stretch 30s each.
sessions.sessionNotes: Reverse pyramid loading. Heavy primary sets, back-off volume sets.

exercises.loadGuidance: Heaviest set first. Drop 5-10% each set.
Add weight plate if bodyweight is easy.

sessions.title: Strength — Day 2: Pull (Back, Biceps)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min row or bike. Dead hangs 2x20s. Light rows 2x10.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Lat stretch 60s each side. Bicep stretch 30s.
sessions.sessionNotes: Heavy rows and pulldowns. Reverse pyramid on compounds.

sessions.title: Strength — Day 3: Lower (Legs, Glutes)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min bike. Bodyweight squats 2x10. Hip circles. Ramp-up sets.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Quad stretch 60s. Pigeon 60s each. Hamstring stretch 60s.
sessions.sessionNotes: Heaviest loading phase. Squat and deadlift are primary. Accessory work is lighter.

exercises.loadGuidance: Heaviest squats of the program. Ramp up properly.

sessions.title: Strength — Day 4: Upper (Full Upper Body)
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min bike. Arm circles, band pull-aparts 2x15. Ramp-up sets.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Full upper body stretch sequence 5 min.
sessions.sessionNotes: Mixed strength and volume. Heavy compounds, lighter isolation.

exercises.loadGuidance: Heavy row. Match your press weight.

phases.title: Restore
phases.goal: Add gentle mobility and restorative strength.

sessions.title: NS Reset — Session 1: Ground
sessions.warmupNotes: None — begin lying down.
sessions.sessionNotes: This is nervous system medicine. No performance metric. Notice, do not fix.

exercises.progressionNotes: Just repeat each session
Build to 4-7-8 breathing pattern
Extend duration
Add cat-cow after in phase 2

sessions.title: NS Reset — Session 2: Breathe
sessions.warmupNotes: Begin seated or lying.
sessions.sessionNotes: Breath-focused session. Extend exhale. Allow release.

exercises.progressionNotes: 4-7-8 pattern in phase 2
Gentle progression
Full-body pandiculation: reach, arch, yawn. Let the body express what it needs.
Flatten lower back into floor on exhale, gently arch on inhale. Slow and deliberate.
Knees bent, feet flat. Arms rest by sides. Allow gravity to do the work.

sessions.title: NS Reset — Session 3: Move Slow
sessions.warmupNotes: Begin lying down.
sessions.sessionNotes: Add slow cat-cow and hip movement. Fluid, not structured.

exercises.progressionNotes: Add hip circles in phase 2
Reach opposite hand and foot diagonally. Feel the full-body connection.
Lie on side. Slowly arc top arm overhead, follow with breath.
Knees together, rotate hips one direction while upper body counters.
Sink into the pose. Breathe into any resistance. Do not force depth.
Full integration. Scan from feet to crown. Notice what has shifted.

sessions.title: NS Restore — Session 7: Gentle Strength
sessions.warmupNotes: Constructive rest 5 min.
sessions.sessionNotes: Add gentle resistance. Banded work. Still low intensity.

exercises.progressionNotes: Add load slowly
Moderate band in phase 2
3-second hold
Slow and controlled. Feel the diagonal connection across your body.
Full-body pandiculation. Yawn, stretch, let the body express.
Closing integration. Knees bent, arms rest. Breathe naturally.

sessions.title: NS Restore — Session 8: Flow & Release
sessions.warmupNotes: Body scan 3 min. Diaphragmatic breathing 2 min.
sessions.sessionNotes: Gentle somatic movement. Cat-cow, spinal twists, hip release. No rushing.

sessions.title: NS Restore — Session 9: Integration Walk
sessions.warmupNotes: Stand and breathe 2 min. Gentle sway.
sessions.sessionNotes: Mindful walk 20 min. Bring awareness to feet, breath, surroundings. Then gentle stretch.

exercises.loadGuidance: Mindful walking. Notice feet and breath.

exercises.progressionNotes: Slow diaphragmatic breathing. 4 count in, 6 count out.
Gentle arch and flatten. Let the spine move with the breath.
Final body scan. Notice what has shifted from the walk.

phases.title: Walk-Dominant
phases.goal: Establish habit. Walk majority with short run intervals.

phases.title: Equal Split
phases.goal: Run intervals increase to match walk periods.

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 1 Session 1
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min gentle walk.
sessions.cooldownNotes: 5 min gentle walk. Calf and quad stretch.
sessions.sessionNotes: Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk x 8. Total 20 min.

exercises.loadGuidance: Conversational pace — if you cannot speak you are going too fast
exercises.progressionNotes: Week 4: 3 min run / 90s walk

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 1 Session 2
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min gentle walk.
sessions.sessionNotes: Same as session 1. Focus on easy conversational pace during jog.

exercises.progressionNotes: Same pattern as session 1. Focus on consistent pace and nasal breathing during walks.

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 1 Session 3
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min gentle walk.
sessions.sessionNotes: Same interval. Notice how it feels easier than day 1.

exercises.progressionNotes: Building confidence with longer run intervals. If 90s feels too much, drop back to 60s.

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 4 Session 1
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min walk.
sessions.sessionNotes: Alternate 3 min jog / 90s walk x 6. Total 27 min.

exercises.loadGuidance: Steady effort — slightly breathless but able to speak short sentences
exercises.progressionNotes: Week 7: 25 min continuous

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 4 Session 2
sessions.warmupNotes: Walk 5 min brisk.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Walk 5 min cool-down. Calf stretch 60s each.
sessions.sessionNotes: Run 3 min / Walk 2 min x 5. Equal effort. Building consistency.

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 4 Session 3
sessions.warmupNotes: Walk 5 min brisk.
sessions.cooldownNotes: Walk 5 min cool-down. Quad stretch 60s each.
sessions.sessionNotes: Run 4 min / Walk 1 min x 5. Pushing toward continuous running.

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 7 Session 1
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min walk.
sessions.sessionNotes: 25 min continuous jog at conversational pace.

exercises.loadGuidance: Easy pace — you should finish feeling like you could have gone further
exercises.progressionNotes: Week 9: 30 min

sessions.title: Walk to Run — Week 9 Session 3
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min walk.
sessions.sessionNotes: 30 min continuous run. Graduation session. Celebrate this.

exercises.progressionNotes: Repeat and build distance

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Learn the lifts — squat, hinge, press, pull. Light loads, perfect form.

phases.title: Build
phases.goal: Add load and reps. Progressive overload across all major patterns.

phases.title: Strength
phases.goal: Heavier compounds, fewer reps. Build raw strength across the body.

sessions.title: Full Body A
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min easy bike + dynamic warmup
sessions.sessionNotes: Hit every major movement pattern.

exercises.tip: Goblet Squat — depth, knees track over toes.
Arnold Press — rotate as you press up.
Barbell Row — pull to lower ribs.
Bicep Curl — slow eccentric, no swing.

sessions.title: Full Body A — Build
sessions.warmupNotes: Activation + ramp-up sets
sessions.sessionNotes: Push to RPE 8 on top sets.

exercises.tip: Romanian Deadlift — hips back, soft knees.

sessions.title: Heavy Squat Day
sessions.warmupNotes: Activation + 4 ramp-up sets
sessions.sessionNotes: 5x5 squat focus. Brace hard.

exercises.tip: Barbell Back Squat — 5x5, heavy and clean.

sessions.title: Full Body B
sessions.warmupNotes: Cat-cow + scap pulls 2x10
sessions.sessionNotes: Switch up exercise variations from Day 1.

exercises.tip: Bulgarian Split Squat — keep torso upright.

sessions.title: Full Body B — Build
sessions.warmupNotes: Cat-cow + scap pulls + ramp-up
sessions.sessionNotes: Volume increases — manage rest carefully.

exercises.tip: Hip Thrust — heavy with full ROM.
Bulgarian Split Squat — load the front leg.

sessions.title: Heavy Press Day
sessions.warmupNotes: Band pull-aparts + scap push-ups
sessions.sessionNotes: 5x5 bench press + heavy rows.

sessions.title: Full Body C
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min row + arm circles
sessions.sessionNotes: Higher rep, lower load — accumulate volume.

sessions.title: Full Body C — Build
sessions.warmupNotes: 5 min row + dynamic warmup
sessions.sessionNotes: Hypertrophy bias — slow eccentrics.

exercises.tip: Goblet Squat — high reps, slow tempo.

sessions.title: Heavy Pull Day
sessions.warmupNotes: Cat-cow + ramp-up sets
sessions.sessionNotes: 5x5 deadlift focus. Reset every rep.
